description: This is a Java interface file defining the PermissionDao interface, which extends a generic DAO and provides methods for managing Permission entities, including listing permissions, retrieving by ID, filtering by groups, and querying by criteria.

classes.name: PermissionDao
classes.description: An interface extending SalesManagerEntityDao with methods specific to Permission entity management.

methods.name: listPermission
methods.description: Returns a list of all Permission objects.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Retrieves a Permission object based on its unique identifier.

methods.name: getPermissionsListByGroups
methods.description: Returns a list of Permissions filtered by a set of permission IDs.

methods.name: listByCriteria
methods.description: Returns a list of Permissions matching specified criteria.
